Udathaneni Satyanarayana vs Sri. S. Ashok Chakravarthy on 26
September, 2025

Author: Surepalli Nanda
Bench: Surepalli Nanda
 Hon'Ble Mrs Justice Surepalli Nanda
 Contempt Case No.2249 of 2023
Order:
Heard Sri Aare Venkateswara Rao, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners and learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of the respondent.
2. Complaining violation of the orders of this Court dated 09.06.2023 passed in W.P.No.2784 of 2023, the present Contempt Case is filed.

3. The relevant portion of the order of this Court, dated 09.06.2023 passed in W.P.No.2784 of 2023 and in particular para No.4 is extracted hereunder:-
4.

Taking into consideration the said submission made by the learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition, the subject issue i.e., compensation amount payable for the land under acquisition to an extent of Ac.9.18 guntas in survey No.107 of Kommepalli Revenue Village in Sathupalli Mandal of Khammam District, pursuant to preliminary notification in Rc.No.G1/2473/2015 dated 23.03.2002 and District Gazette Notification No.A3/15/2022, dated 01.04.2022 issued under Section 11 (1) of Central Act, 30 of 2013 is directed to be referred to the competent authority under sections 76 and 77 of the Act by the 3rd respondent within a period of two (02) weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
4. Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of the respondent contends that the order of this Court, dated 09.06.2023 passed in W.P.No.2784 of 2023 had been duly complied with and the matter referred to the competent Authority under Sections 76 & 77 of the Act by the Revenue Divisional Officer, Kalluru, Khamam District and to that effect learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of the respondent brought on record the written instructions of the Land Acquisition Officer & Sub Collector, Kalluru.
5.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners contends that total extent of Ac.9.18 guntas in survey No.107 of Kommepalli Revenue Village in Sathupalli Mandal of Khammam District had not been referred to the competent Authority under Sections 76 & 77 of the Act by the Revenue Divisional Officer, Kalluru, Khamam District as directed by this Court in its order, dated 09.06.2023 passed in W.P.No.2784 of 2023 and land to an extent of 1.29 guntas is still left out and

hence, the plea of the learned Government Pleader appearing on behalf of the respondent that total extent of Udathaneni Satyanarayana vs Sri. S. Ashok Chakravarthy on 26 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130809496/
1 Ac.9.18 gunts in survey No.107 of Kommepalli Revenue Village in Sathupalli Mandal of Khammam District had been referred to the competent Authority under Sections 76 & 77 of the Act by the Revenue Divisional Officer, Kalluru, Khamam District is incorrect and therefore, the 3rd respondent is liable for punishment under the contempt of Courts Act, 1971.

6. Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of the respondent on the other hand disputes the said plea put-forth by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners and draws attention of this Court to the statement at Serial No.8 pertaining to the particulars of the subject acquisition of the land in the written instructions of Land Acquisition Officer & Sub Collector, Kalluru and contends that land to an extent of Ac.1.29 guntas in Sy.No.107/8 is under scrutiny at LARR authority and soon after the scrutiny, appropriate action would be initiated in respect of the said land to an extent of Ac. 1.29 guntas in Sy.No.107/8 of Kommepalli Revenue Village in Sathupalli Mandal of Khammam District and therefore, the contempt case could be closed.
7. Taking into consideration:-
a) The aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case.
b) The submissions made by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners and learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of the respondents.
b) The order of this Court, dated 09.06.2023 passed in W.P.No.2784 of 2023 (referred to and extracted above)
c) Proceedings No.A/15/2022, dated 04.11.2023 of the Revenue Divisional Officer,
Kalluru d) Written instructions of the Land Acquisition Officer & Sub Collector, Kalluru filed before this Court on this day i.e., on 26.09.2025.
e) That out of entire Ac.9.18 guntas only Ac.1.29 guntas of land in the said Sy.No.107/8 had been left out and not referred to the competent Authority under Sections 76 & 77 of the Act by the Revenue Divisional Officer, Kalluru, Khammam District, since, the same is under scrutiny at LARR Authority.
This Court opines that there is no deliberate violation of the order of this Court, dated 09.06.2023 passed in W.P.No.2784 of 2023, the respondent herein is however directed to comply with the orders of this Court, dated 09.06.2023 passed in W.P.No.2784 of 2023 in respect of the said left out land as well to an extent of Ac.1.29 guntas in Sy.No.107/8 of Kommepalli Revenue Village in Sathupalli Mandal of Khammam District, duly referring the said extent as well to the competent Authority under Sections 76 & 77 of the Act, after conclusion of due scrutiny and duly comply with the order of this Court, dated 09.06.2023 passed in W.P.No.2784 of 2023 in its true spirit, within a Udathaneni Satyanarayana vs Sri. 2 period of two (02) weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and accordingly, present contempt case is closed.
